summary: 10 countries today. The Iran sanctions push and the carrier swap in the Gulf still lead abroad, but the day spreads wider than that: a federal trial over Meta and children, US debt past 40 trillion dollars, the shortened Korea drills, Chinese countermeasures on trade, a Kakao Mobility listing in New York, an Argentine anti-abortion pact signed in Buenos Aires, and Carlos Alcaraz cleared for the US Open.

items.title: Meta sued by US states for hooking and exploiting kids in pursuit of profit
items.note: A coalition of 29 states is seeking 200 billion dollars. French coverage treats the case as a test of whether US courts will regulate American platforms at all.

items.title: Panama Canal to cut daily ship traffic as drought worsens from El Nino
items.note: Roughly two thirds of canal traffic is bound for or leaving US ports, so the cut lands first on American shippers.
